_comment: SCE Mesh §16.7 / RFC F.X-4 Stage C — codegen-time vsomeip metadata. NOT loaded at runtime; the per-binary configs (Stage D `*_alpha.json` / `*_beta.json`) provide the live SCE app + offered machine-level liveness service + SD timings the routing manager actually uses. This file only supplies the `peer_svc` service-name → numeric-ID mapping that each machine's OEM-style `#alpha`/`#beta` binding (transport: someip + service: peer_svc + events:) needs to resolve at codegen time. The dead `<send target="#beta">` / `<send target="#alpha">` never fire (TestSenderEngine bypasses onentry), so peer_svc carries no runtime traffic; it exists purely so the codegen emits `someip` into transport_types and the vsomeip include + consolidated SCE app field both fire. Service ID 0x9100 is well outside the SCE-reserved invoke (0x8100..0x817F), region-liveness (0x8180..0x81FF), and machine-liveness (0x8280..0x82FF) ranges so no collision is possible.
